games.name: Steel Titans
games.desc:
Steel Titans is one of the most realistic and historically accurate tank games on Roblox with over 160 tanks to choose from!


Controls:
WASD- move
Left click- Fire
Right click- Scope view
123- Change selected ammo for primary gun
456- change selected ammo for secondary gun
Space- Fire secondary gun(s)
E- spot
Q- binoculars
Tab- view score menu
X- X-ray to view modules
C- Turret lock
V- change view
T- toggle special action
